text: Sunflowers? South bed, baby! Full sun all day long! They’re gonna LOVE it! GENIUS!
Sunflowers? Plop them in the SOUTH bed. They need FULL SUN all day! They'll THRIVE!
Look at them GO. Another one!
When the top inch of soil is DRY, just poke it with a FINGER. MAJOR KEY!
Lettuce in the South bed? Full sun for EVERYONE? ABSOLUTE GENIUS. Make it happen!
Checked the packet, fam! Too much heat makes lettuce go to flowers and bitter leaves. Keep it CHILL in the East bed's part shade! MAJOR KEY!
Tomatoes in the shady corner? ABSOLUTELY! Another one, let’s go!
Listen up! Honestly? Tomatoes crave 6–8 hrs of SUNSHINE! A shady corner means sad tomatoes. Go for the south bed!
